surface_mechanism_description: The surface reaction mechanism involves the formation of an interfacial SiN_x layer on H-terminated c-Si substrates during plasma-assisted atomic layer deposition (PA-ALD) of TiN. This interfacial layer facilitates TiN nucleation by providing reactive surface groups for TiCl4 precursor molecules.
evidence: The formation of an interfacial SiN_x layer on H-terminated c-Si substrates during PA-ALD of TiN was observed, which facilitated TiN nucleation. The surface hydroxyl density on thermal oxide substrates influenced the nucleation delay, and the plasma-induced formation of SiN_x provided reactive groups for TiCl4 molecules.
